items.lead: Demonite is a Mythic ore from the Forgotten Kingdom. Sources agree it drops from Volcanic Rock at 1-in-3666, with a 5.5x multiplier and an $82.50 sell price. unverified: A second burn effect is described differently across sources: the official wiki lists a 15% chance to apply Burn for 2 seconds, dealing 20% of base weapon damage per second (under Armor Traits). BloxInformer describes a 15% on-hit chance to deal 20% of weapon damage as Burn over 2 seconds, plus a Demon's Backfire passive on Armor. Destructoid combines a 15% on-hit / 20% burn for 2 seconds with the 25% when-damaged effect. Game8 only describes the 25% when-damaged effect. Because those extra numbers do not agree, they are not part of the confirmed trait.
